# Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyr, dplyr, ggplot2, readr, lubridate, tibble, stringr,
               knitr, broom, fixest, here)
```

# Import ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
load("../data/u_processed/monthly_panel_nuts3_AT_DE_FR.RData")
nuts3_panel <- monthly_panel_nuts3_AT_DE_FR
```

# Parameters --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

t0 <- as.Date("2023-01-01")  # Intervention date

# Analysis time window
pre_window  <- 4
post_window <- 12

# Incumbent market criteria (evaluated over pre-treatment period only)
min_pre_active_months <- 4
min_pre_mean_outlets  <- 2
min_first_active_date <- as.Date("2022-01-01")
```

# Preprocess: Build balanced panel ----------------------------------------------------------

## Step 1: Filter DE + AT
```{r}
#| echo: false

step1_data <- nuts3_panel %>%
  mutate(Month = as.Date(Month)) %>%
  filter(Country %in% c("DE", "AT"))
```

## Step 2: Aggregate duplicates
```{r}
#| echo: false

step2_data <- step1_data %>%
  group_by(NUTS3, Country, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    CheckoutCount   = sum(CheckoutCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_stores        = sum(n_stores, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_stores_active = sum(n_stores_active, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Step 3: Create balanced panel
```{r}
#| echo: false

all_months      <- sort(unique(step2_data$Month))
nuts3_country_ids <- step2_data %>% distinct(NUTS3, Country)

step3_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(nuts3_country_ids, Month = all_months) %>%
  left_join(step2_data, by = c("NUTS3", "Country", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(
    CheckoutCount   = replace_na(CheckoutCount, 0L),
    n_stores        = replace_na(n_stores, 0L),
    n_stores_active = replace_na(n_stores_active, 0L)
  )
```

## Step 4: Add time variables
```{r}
#| echo: false

step4_data <- step3_data %>%
  mutate(
    treat = as.integer(Country == "DE"),
    post  = as.integer(Month >= t0),
    did   = as.integer(treat & post),
    ttt   = 12 * (year(Month) - year(t0)) + (month(Month) - month(t0)),
    moy   = as.factor(month(Month))
  )
```

## Step 5: Derived variables and weights
```{r}
#| echo: false

step5_data <- step4_data %>%
  mutate(
    transactions_per_store = if_else(n_stores > 0, CheckoutCount / n_stores, 0),
    transactions_per_active_store = if_else(n_stores_active > 0,
                                             CheckoutCount / n_stores_active, 0),
    activation_rate = if_else(n_stores > 0, n_stores_active / n_stores, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(NUTS3, Country) %>%
  mutate(w = pmax(mean(n_stores[ttt >= -pre_window & ttt <= -1], na.rm = TRUE), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Step 6: Identify incumbent markets
```{r}
#| echo: false

activity_timeline <- step5_data %>%
  filter(n_stores > 0) %>%
  group_by(NUTS3, Country) %>%
  summarise(
    first_active    = min(Month),
    last_active     = max(Month),
    n_active_months = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pre_treatment_stats <- step5_data %>%
  filter(ttt >= -pre_window & ttt <= -1) %>%
  group_by(NUTS3, Country) %>%
  summarise(
    pre_active_months = sum(n_stores > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pre_mean_outlets  = mean(n_stores, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(activity_timeline, by = c("NUTS3", "Country"))

incumbent_df <- pre_treatment_stats %>%
  filter(
    pre_active_months >= min_pre_active_months,
    pre_mean_outlets  >= min_pre_mean_outlets,
    first_active      <= min_first_active_date
  ) %>%
  select(NUTS3, Country) %>%
  mutate(is_incumbent = 1L)
```

## Step 7: Add incumbent flag and create final datasets
```{r}
#| echo: false

step7_data <- step5_data %>%
  left_join(incumbent_df, by = c("NUTS3", "Country")) %>%
  mutate(is_incumbent = replace_na(is_incumbent, 0L))

# Full balanced panel (all time, incumbent markets only)
panel_full <- step7_data %>% filter(is_incumbent == 1)

# DiD analysis panel (analysis window, incumbent markets only)
panel_did <- step7_data %>%
  filter(is_incumbent == 1, ttt >= -pre_window & ttt <= post_window)

panel_nuts3_DE_AT <- panel_did
```

# Sample Descriptives -----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Average checkout counts over time — for context plot (saved to assets)
avg_checkouts_DE_AT_full <- panel_full %>%
  filter(Month >= as.Date("2022-04-01"), Month <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>%
  group_by(Month, Country) %>%
  summarise(avg_checkout = mean(CheckoutCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_checkout_full <- ggplot(avg_checkouts_DE_AT_full,
                          aes(x = Month, y = avg_checkout, color = Country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(t0), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DE" = "#0072B2", "AT" = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Average Checkout Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("assets", "objects", "fig-checkout-full-timerange.png"),
       plot = p_checkout_full, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Model: DiD Event Study (Poisson PPML) -----------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Load store-level data to count unique stores for sample descriptives
load("../data/u_processed/monthly_panel_stores_AT_DE_FR.RData")

stores_in_sample <- monthly_panel_stores_AT_DE_FR %>%
  mutate(Month = as.Date(Month)) %>%
  filter(
    Country %in% c("DE", "AT"),
    NUTS3 %in% unique(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$NUTS3),
    Month >= min(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$Month),
    Month <= max(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$Month)
  )

cat("=== Sample Descriptives for DiD Analysis ===\n\n")
cat("Region-months:", nrow(panel_nuts3_DE_AT), "\n")
cat("Unique NUTS3:", n_distinct(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$NUTS3), "\n")
cat("  DE:", n_distinct(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$NUTS3[panel_nuts3_DE_AT$Country == "DE"]), "\n")
cat("  AT:", n_distinct(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$NUTS3[panel_nuts3_DE_AT$Country == "AT"]), "\n")
cat("Total checkouts:", format(sum(panel_nuts3_DE_AT$CheckoutCount), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Unique stores:", format(n_distinct(stores_in_sample$StoreId), big.mark = ","), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

mod1_nuts3 <- fepois(
  CheckoutCount ~ i(ttt, treat, ref = -1) | NUTS3 + Month,
  cluster = ~NUTS3,
  data    = panel_nuts3_DE_AT
)

# Save raw coefficients for supplement table
did_coef_table <- as.data.frame(coeftable(mod1_nuts3))
did_coef_table$Term <- rownames(did_coef_table)
did_coef_table <- did_coef_table %>%
  select(Term, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `z value`, `Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  rename(SE = `Std. Error`, z = `z value`, p = `Pr(>|z|)`)

dir.create(here("assets", "objects"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(did_coef_table, here("assets", "objects", "did_coef_table.rds"))
```

# Figure: Event Study -----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: fig-event-study
#| fig-cap: "**The mandate initially increased container transactions but effects reversed from month 4 onward.** Difference-in-differences event-study estimates of mandate effects on monthly container transactions; German NUTS-3 regions (treatment) versus Austrian regions (control); reference period t = −1. Error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals based on standard errors clustered at the NUTS-3 level. Horizontal dashed line at zero indicates no treatment effect; vertical dashed line marks mandate implementation (t = 0). Pre-treatment coefficients (t = −4 to −2) provide a visual test of the parallel trends assumption. n = 388 regions; 6,984 region-months."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

iplot(mod1_nuts3,
      xlab = "Time to treatment (months)",
      main = "")
```
